sinopsis.es: Dos familias visitan a sus padres, que comparten una habitación de hospital. Mientras una discute por problemas cotidianos, la otra ve la situación de una manera muy distinta.
sinopsis.en: Members of two families are visiting their hospitalized fathers sharing the same room. While one family squabbles over trivial issues, the other family takes a very different perspective. Flowers are both for celebrations and for funerals.
